education.title: Data Analysis Bootcamp - Cambridge Spark
description: Building upon my existing knowledge in Python, I strengthened my skills during the 10-week Data Analysis Bootcamp at Cambridge Spark. The program covered Pandas for data processing and analysis, along with data visualization using Pandas, Seaborn, and Bokeh. A module on Maths for Data Analysis deepened my understanding of key mathematical concepts, while an emphasis on storytelling with data helped me learn how to craft clear, engaging narratives for different audiences.

A highlight of the course was the practical Hackathon, where I applied these skills to real-world problems. The bootcamp also introduced me to statistical programming, data mining, and SQL, providing a strong foundation in data analysis and enriching my ability to work with complex datasets.

education.title: IThub College
description: During my four years at IThub College, I earned a diploma in Front-End Web Development, along with certifications such as IC3 Computing Fundamentals and Microsoft's Introduction to Programming Using JavaScript. The program gave me a strong foundation in modern web technologies while also broadening my knowledge across related IT fields.

My studies included UX/UI principles, database management with SQL, PostgreSQL, and MySQL, and programming in JavaScript, Python, and Dart (Flutter). I also gained exposure to project management, testing, and DevOps practices, equipping me with versatile skills to contribute across different areas of software development and IT.

experience.title: Strange Tech
description: At Strange Tech I work as a versatile developer on client sites, including Halfords Business and Daytona, as part of a team. Day-to-day that means WordPress (EtchWP, ACF, ACSS), Laravel, React, and Flutter - building and refining UIs, and keeping sites accessible, fast, and SEO-ready.
I also support backend work, fix bugs, and pick up whatever the project needs. Full-stack support within the team, adapting quickly to different technologies and requirements.
